svg.title: Five boards later
svg.desc: Timeline of hardware options: HP ProDesk 400 G4, Beelink SER8 and Minisforum MS-01 were dropped, an i7-12650HX engineering-sample board was swapped out, and a board sold as i7-1255U with 32 GB RAM and a 1 TB SSD is running now.

g.text: How I ended up with one small box.
